lemmas.primary_translation: what is done cannot be undone; it is binding

definitions.text: i kortspill: utspilt kort må ligge; i overført betydning: gjort er gjort
definitions.translation: in card games: a card that has been played must remain where it lies; figuratively: what is done is done (lit. the table catches [the card])

definitions.text: i overført betydning: en handling eller et utsagn kan ikke kalles tilbake og er bindende
definitions.translation: figuratively: an action or statement cannot be taken back and is binding
